paper_title: Search for invisible axion dark matter of mass m$_a=43~μ$eV with the QUAX--$aγ$ experiment
notes: Haloscope search for axion dark matter at m_a ≈ 43 µeV (4.3e-5 eV). The paper reports a 90% C.L. upper limit of g_agamma < 0.766 × 10^-13 GeV^-1 at the cavity resonance frequency ν_c = 10.40176 GHz, corresponding to axion mass m_a = 43.0182 µeV. The limit is valid in a narrow mass window of Δm_a = 3.7 neV around the central mass. Local DM density assumed ρ_a ≈ 0.45 GeV/cm³ (standard galactic halo model). The experiment uses a copper cavity in an 8.1 T magnetic field cooled to ~150-200 mK with a Josephson parametric amplifier at the SQL. Data collected over ~1 hour (4203 s). No signal detected; result interpreted as exclusion limit. The coupling value is encoded as a horizontal line (mass-independent within the narrow search window) at the two endpoints of the mass range. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.95, 2))
